nodes.description: Owner address state variable declared in Owned; set to msg.sender at construction and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address state variable in Owned; set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.

Public uint8 decimals (8) set in FatumCoin constructor.
Total token supply state variable; minted entirely to the deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances, mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
Pure helper computing c = a + b with an overflow require check.
Pure helper computing c = a - b with require(b <= a) underflow check.
Pure helper computing c = a * b with an overflow division check.
Pure helper computing c = a / b with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender, an unprotected privilege assignment.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; guards transferOwnership and transferAnyERC20Token.
onlyOwner function staging newOwner for a two-step ownership transfer.
Requires msg.sender == newOwner, then commits ownership and clears newOwner.
Constructor initialising metadata and minting the whole supply to a hardcoded address.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with an unchecked subtraction.
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on the balances mapping.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no zero-reset protection.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract before state finalisation, enabling reentrancy.
Payable fallback that always reverts, refusing plain ETH.
onlyOwner function performing an external call to an arbitrary token contract to rescue tokens.
Caller-controlled address used for authentication, ownership and balance bookkeeping throughout the contract.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) on a user-supplied contract address without reentrancy protection.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied token contract inside an onlyOwner function.
Addition c = a + b in safeAdd; guarded by require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b in safeSub; guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b in safeMul; guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division c = a / b in safeDiv; guarded by require(b > 0).
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply(), which can underflow if address(0) ever holds a balance.
